title: Migrate Auritus-web (cut over aurit.us) onto the standard front end

comments.author: home
comments.text: Code migrated and published to the candidate; cut-over blocked. Auritus-web PR #6 (merged): web/projection.json + web/hooks.py replace web/projector.py (211) and scripts/project_local.py (66) (-277; +93 hooks, +74 settings, offers.py kept 76). Core additions (5.1.0): static.copy and sitemap.extra (PR #416), body_class hook and authored home description (PR #413). Parity vs previous candidate, 118 URLs: 0 blocking (DOM identical on 21 pages; 404 intentionally regenerated). Behave suite 14 scenarios pass against the 5.1.0 handler (submodule bumped to cb5dd78). Candidate: published to bucket auritus-marketing-publication-publicationbucket-d3u4zvo1lmsr (papyrus-production 712236451410) with scripts/publish_s3.py; candidate distribution E1VM6E6VYPBQ0B (dmliybjlyvh56.cloudfront.net): all 20 sitemap URLs 200, .html redirect, 404, robots, sitemap. Cut-over needs: aurit.us zone Z0891357UAST0841IMEZ is authoritative in the LEGACY account (dig NS matches); needs a papyrus-production zone with the existing records and a registrar NS change (Ryan), an ACM cert for aurit.us in us-east-1, an alias parameter on the marketing-publication stack (none today), the apex alias record, and live-route parity of the legacy Next export vs web/site (README: hashes differ). No Amplify app is connected to Auritus-web (GitHub handshake pending), so there is no push-triggered pipeline yet.

comments.author: home
comments.text: aurit.us is live (2026-10-21 UTC). Cert 58cbc45c-9fee-478f-994d-49954b88b6b2 (us-east-1, papyrus-production 712236451410) validated in legacy zone Z0891357UAST0841IMEZ; alias param on stack auritus-marketing-publication (Auritus-web PR 7); distribution E1VM6E6VYPBQ0B (dmliybjlyvh56.cloudfront.net). aurit.us A and AAAA aliases in the legacy zone now point there; www has no record (unchanged). The first parity pass found the retained docs/examples pages older than live (license wording, sample audio); they were refreshed from live and then matched live text for all 18 routes, all referenced assets 200. Home and pricing carry the new offers-driven content by design. The Amplify domain association for aurit.us on app d1xec2o22j5yq2 was removed to free the alias; app kept. Rollback: re-create that association and point the A alias back at d11nqalufqzgfu.cloudfront.net.
